description: Bid submission form completed and signed by the authorised signatory
Certificate of incorporation or business registration certificate
Trading licence valid for the current year
Valid tax clearance certificate from the revenue authority
Certificate of non-blacklisting or non-debarment
Power of attorney authorising the signatory of the bid
Registration with the professional or sector regulator governing the works or services
Audited financial statements for the last two financial years
Bid security in the form and amount stated in the bidding document
Banker's reference or evidence of access to a line of credit
Priced bill of quantities or price schedule
Statement of similar works completed or experience record
Curricula vitae of the proposed key personnel
Schedule of plant and equipment available for the assignment
Work programme or methodology statement
Anti-bribery and anti-corruption declaration signed by the bidder
Signed conflict of interest declaration
Beneficial ownership disclosure form
Signed code of ethical conduct for bidders
Evidence of professional indemnity or third party liability insurance
Certificate of compliance with statutory social security contributions
Statement of litigation history or pending disputes
